title: Sharpness-Aware Gradient Matching for Domain Generalization (SAGM)
mechanism: Minimise empirical risk, perturbed loss and their gap together, aligning gradient directions; better DG than SAM at equal cost.
adaptation: Drop-in replacement for SAM in the PF recipe; target E1. Run only if SAM moves E1.
evidence: Outperforms SOTA on PACS, VLCS, OfficeHome, TerraIncognita, DomainNet (classification).
min_experiment: Arm PF+SAGM vs PF+SAM vs PF, seeds 5-9. Metric: E1 crack relF1@2, E1 inactive IoU. Kill if not above PF+SAM on E1.
